task: Oracle CCIHP person-by-native-garment color classification; not official characterized parsing AP
label_space: CCIHP Color_ids 1..12; original README includes navy in Dark; garment types can include dress parts

eligibility.mask: Human_ids>0 AND Category_ids equals native garment ID; color IDs never restrict input pixels
eligibility.ambiguous_regions: EXCLUDED_WITH_COUNTS before model fitting, independently of predictions

features.shared: prototype_rules_v2 58-element descriptor plus 4 native-garment one-hot values
features.erosion: same optional 5x5 ellipse with documented small-region fallback for baseline and learned model
features.RGB: PIL RGB uint8 original grid; no color jitter or augmentation

training.checkpoint_selection: lowest calibration cross-entropy, earliest epoch in exact tie

metrics.primary: strict per-region accuracy on exact frozen eligible validation membership
metrics.unknown: excluded by GT eligibility with retained reasons; no score-based exclusions

resources.other_GPU_processes: do not modify; free memory guard applies

CCTV.selection: 6day+6night deterministic SHA order; no model scores
CCTV.parsing: reuse saved M2FP packets only; no new segmentation inference
CCTV.reason: color label provenance is mixed/unknown, grayscale/IR hue may be unobservable

evidence_limit: Exploratory pilot after previous studies, not a preregistered independent final confirmation; no full 5000-image benchmark or deployment acceptance.
artifact_policy: Fresh outputs/t4-pilot-<UTC> for manifests/features/checkpoint/predictions/logs; do not publish model trained on NC dataset or CCTV assets automatically. Publish compact aggregate metrics/code/provenance only.
